subject.title: feat: add publisher follow controls and discovery

question: Should ClawHub accept publisher follows as a core discovery/notification preference surface once the stacked API proof and docs are complete?
rationale: The implementation is a new user-facing follow graph and private follow-state API, so automation cannot decide the product/API boundary or whether to land the stacked feature slices independently.

options.title: Keep paused until the base API clears
options.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to settle auth-boundary proof, public docs, generated artifacts, and maintainer API direction before final review of this UI slice.

options.title: Review the full follow stack together
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally review the API, controls/discovery, and notification PRs as one feature stack and own the private follow-state boundary together.

options.title: Retarget or close if follows are rejected
options.body: If the follow graph is not accepted as core ClawHub behavior, this controls branch should be paused, retargeted, or closed rather than carried as a conflicting stack.

recommendation.title: Keep paused until the base API clears
recommendation.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to settle auth-boundary proof, public docs, generated artifacts, and maintainer API direction before final review of this UI slice.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history ties this API/schema/docs and publisher UI baseline to Patrick-Erichsen's merged area work, making them the best available product/API routing candidate from the observed repository history.
